temporal_policy: Dataset-level temporal coverage is the evidence-backed model simulation or calibration period. Year precision is represented as YYYY-01-01 through YYYY-12-31.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Transient-model stress-period description: annual periods 1950-1979 and monthly periods January 1980-December 2012
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The numerical report identifies 1950-1979 as annual transient periods and January 1980 through December 2012 as monthly transient periods; the steady-state period is an initial condition.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Numerical report p. 22, Table 4: annual transient periods representing 1957-2012
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The final Blossom model report defines the transient annual stress-period sequence from 1957 through 2012.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Transient-model description: transient conditions from 1948 through 2002; pre-1948 steady state
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The model report distinguishes the pre-1948 steady-state condition from the transient simulation period 1948-2002.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Final report stress-period summary: 75 stress periods spanning 1931-2005, with the first period steady state
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Capitan report states that the model has 75 stress periods covering 1931-2005; the initial steady-state period is retained as the modeled start boundary.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Current v3.02 report/model-page calibration-period description: 1930-2020
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The current central Carrizo-Wilcox v3.02 documentation describes calibration across 1930-2020; this is a year-precision catalog boundary, not a claim about every input file's time step.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Table 2.4-1, Stress Period Setup: steady state 1980 and annual transient periods 1981-2013
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The numerical report explicitly lists the initial 1980 steady-state period followed by annual transient periods through 2013.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: v3.1 report transient-model stress-period description: 1981-2017 after the initial steady-state period
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The current Southern Carrizo-Wilcox v3.1 report describes the transient historical sequence through 2017; the initial steady-state condition is not represented as a dated transient year.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Model-page/report description: 10-year transient simulation with 120 monthly stress periods, 1989-1998
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Barton Springs report describes a 10-year transient model with monthly stress periods covering 1989-1998.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: v2.1 report stress-period setup: initial steady state 1980 and 432 monthly periods through 2015
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The final Northern Edwards v2.1 report identifies the historical model period as 1980-2015, including the initial steady-state year.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: USGS report model-simulation description: calibration 1947-1990 and verification 1991-2000
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The authoritative USGS report documents the San Antonio segment model simulation from 1947 through 2000, including calibration and verification periods.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Numerical report calibrated-model period description: 1930-2005
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Edwards-Trinity Plateau/Pecos Valley model report describes the calibrated historical model period as 1930-2005.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Model report stress-period summary: one steady-state period and 37 transient periods representing 1963-1999
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The GMA 16 report identifies the 37 transient periods as 1963-1999; the initial steady-state period is the model initial condition.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Final report stress-period description: initial pseudo-steady condition by 1980 and transient periods 1981-2015
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The central/southern Gulf Coast report defines the historical model sequence beginning with the 1980 initial condition and continuing through 2015.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: v4.1/GULF2023 stress-period history: 1897-2018
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The current Northern Gulf Coast v4.1 model documentation uses the GULF2023 stress-period history from 1897 through 2018.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: SAF2/model configuration time-discretization description: 1979 steady state, annual periods 1980-2042
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Cross Timbers model configuration includes the 1979 initial steady-state period and annual historical/predictive periods through 2042, so the catalog exposes the full configured model range.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Numerical model and 2025 extension reports: original calibration 1930-2012 and extension through 2018
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The current HPAS archive combines the original model with the 2025 extension; the evidence-backed historical/calibrated coverage ends in 2018, before predictive scenarios.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: USGS report transient discretization: annual periods 1903-1968 and monthly periods 1969-2002
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Hueco Bolson report explicitly defines the transient historical sequence from 1903 through 2002.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Mesilla model report temporal-model section: historical simulation period 1915-2002
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Mesilla Bolson report documents the historical model simulation period as 1915-2002; the catalog uses year precision because the report does not establish a finer archive-wide boundary.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Model report transient-model description: steady state before 1950 and transient simulation 1950-2000
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The IGBL report distinguishes the pre-1950 steady-state condition from the transient simulation period 1950-2000.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Numerical report transient-model stress-period description: 1950-2005
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Kinney County alternative model report defines the historical transient model period as 1950-2005.

archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Lipan report identifies the dated transient stress periods as 1980-1999; the pre-1980 condition is a steady-state warm-up and is not presented as a dated transient period.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Numerical report stress-period setup: period 1 pseudo-steady by 1980 and transient periods 1981-2010
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Llano Uplift report defines the initial pseudo-steady condition by 1980 and transient periods 1981-2010; the dataset boundary includes the initial dated model condition.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Numerical report stress-period table: initial 1984 steady state and annual transient periods through 2013
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Lower Rio Grande Valley model report identifies 1984-2013 as the historical modeled sequence.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Nacatoch report transient calibration description: 1980-1997, after 1978-1979 warm-up
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Nacatoch report identifies 1980-1997 as the transient calibration period; the earlier warm-up years are not exposed as the primary calibration coverage.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Final report Table 9.2.1: transient calibration period 1939-2008
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Rustler report explicitly labels 1939-2008 as the entire transient calibration period.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Seymour/Blaine model report historical stress-period description: 1950-2005
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Seymour/Blaine archive's model report defines the historical model period as 1950-2005; predictive scenarios are not included in this catalog boundary.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Report stress-period description: annual periods 1950-1979 and monthly periods 1980-2005
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Seymour HKB report explicitly describes the transient historical sequence from 1950 through 2005.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Current v3.01 documentation and calibration description: historical transient calibration through 2012, beginning in 1980
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The current Northern Trinity/Woodbine archive is cataloged against its documented historical calibration period 1980-2012; earlier predevelopment setup is not treated as the primary observed-data interval.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Model report simulation description: initial 1980 condition and predictive simulations through 2050
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Southern Trinity archive documents a historical initial condition in 1980 and predictive simulations through 2050, so the full configured range is exposed.

archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: WTBL is a steady-state model rather than a dated transient history; the report's 1900-2006 observation window is the evidence-backed temporal coverage for its calibration data.

archives.temporal_evidence_location: Final report transient stress-period description: annual model periods 1948-2008 after warm-up
archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Presidio-Redford Bolson report explicitly identifies 1948-2008 as the dated transient model period.

archives.temporal_evidence_rationale: The Yegua-Jackson report identifies 1980-1997 as the transient calibration period; the earlier setup years are not the primary calibration coverage.
